newsitem.title: USA: Oklahoma Gas & Electric to issue debt.
newsitem.headline: Oklahoma Gas & Electric to issue debt.

text.p: OGE Energy Corp's Oklahoma Gas & Electric Co is expected to tap the corporate bond market with a $250 million two-part debt offering on Tuesday, dealers said.
The first tranche is expected to consist of a $125 million 20-year issue, putable in the seventh year, and is expected to be underwritten by Lehman Brothers, dealers said.
The second tranche will consist of a $125 million 30-year tranche, putable in the tenth year, and is expected to be underwritten by Merrill Lynch & Co, dealers said.
The deal is expected to be rated Aa3/AA-minus, they said.
